def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining = bins - item
    valid = remaining >= 0
    pri = np.full_like(bins, -1e9)
    
    if np.any(valid):
        # Calculate fill ratio (how full the bin would be after adding item)
        fill_ratio = (bins[valid] - remaining[valid]) / bins[valid]
        # Combine minimal leftover space with fill ratio preference
        pri[valid] = -remaining[valid] + fill_ratio * 10
    
    return pri

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining = bins - item
    valid = remaining >= 0
    pri = np.full_like(bins, -1e9)
    optimal_remaining = 0.3 * bins.max()  # Example: aim for bins with ~30% remaining capacity
    pri[valid] = -np.abs(remaining[valid] - optimal_remaining)
    return pri
